questions.q: In "What a lead is, and who needs more of them Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Present to a review room: the business, the funnel, the consent line, the numbers and your decision.
Draw the funnel on one page: where a stranger first sees the offer, the page they land on, the form they fill, the first reply they get.

questions.q: In "Kick-off circle Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Peers ask three questions: who is it for, why you, what could go wrong.
Email basics: a clear subject, a short message, one next step, a real sender name, an unsubscribe line. Never buy lists of strangers.
Revised cost per lead = 800 / 56, about 14.3 (rounded).
Fix the biggest drop-out step and run three more days.
